newMaterialFindings.title: Durable reservations inherit the app's silent memory fallback
newMaterialFindings.path: When the localStorage getter throws, app storage becomes null and kv.setItem succeeds in memoryStorage. The same kv is passed to JobReservations, whose usable checks only WebLocks. With locks available, reservation therefore succeeds, the provider starts and the UI promises window-close recovery although the only operation capability/receipt disappears with the page. The server retains an orphaned ready result the browser can no longer retrieve.
newMaterialFindings.relatedReadFailure: kv.getItem also catches a storage read error and returns null. For job reservations, unreadable must not be treated as an empty reservation envelope that can be overwritten.
newMaterialFindings.minimumFix: Give durable jobs a persistence-required browser storage adapter/availability gate that propagates read/write denial and never falls back to memory. Fail before provider creation if receipt persistence cannot be established. Legacy project/UI fallback behavior can remain separately.
newMaterialFindings.smallAcceptanceCase: Inject localStorage getter denial while WebLocks exist, and separate getItem read denial with potential later write success. Assert no provider create and no recovery promise/reservation replacement. Not executed by this reviewer.

newMaterialFindings.title: Recovered operations silently adopt the current sequence instead of the captured sequence
newMaterialFindings.path: binding.seq is captured but never read in map-run recovery/application. After another tab saves the entry while the job runs, reload opens the newest WorkspaceStore ref, attaches the old operation and commits with that newest ref. If map/source checks pass, the old job is accepted despite the original base sequence having changed. This is exactly the implicit newer-seq adoption the100 contract says not to use.
newMaterialFindings.minimumFix: Define and enforce recovered baseSeq ownership before apply while preserving97's explicitly allowed same-page edits. A sound policy can distinguish saves made/owned by the live requesting visit from a reload/other-tab snapshot; do not simply reject all independent edits. Applied-reading reconciliation is a separate allowed path and should precede apply checks.
newMaterialFindings.smallAcceptanceCase: Start job at seqN, save unrelated edit from another tab toN+1, reload requesting tab and explicitly apply. Assert the selected stale-seq policy without silently adoptingN+1. Also retain a same-page permitted-edit case. Not executed by this reviewer.

newMaterialFindings.title: Server immutable ownership binding is returned but ignored during recovery
newMaterialFindings.path: Server view includes the operation's immutable binding. Client JobView omits it, call accepts any response ID with a known state, and load checks inputHash/askHash/prompt only. EntryId/projectId/lifecycle/seq and result model are not compared to the server binding. A structurally valid altered browser reservation can retain the real opID/cap/input hashes but point at another imported entry sharing the same Project.id, source IDs and area IDs. same() and applyReading can then pass, apply to the imported copy and ack away the original entry's result.
newMaterialFindings.minimumFix: Validate response operation ID and the entire server binding against the stored reservation before consuming status, loading a result or acknowledging it; compare result model/prompt/hash to that binding too. Reconcile saved reading only after confirming stored projectId/lifecycle/entry ownership. Input hashes bind the input, not the separate locally editable ownership fields.
newMaterialFindings.normalFlowQualification: Normal importCopy creates a new entryId, so same Project.id alone does not redirect a sound receipt. Trash/restore after a reading was already committed retains that reading; acking it can merely clean up a prior success. Those normal actions alone are not being reported as proven wrong-entry application. The demonstrated gap is the missing rejection of altered/corrupt ownership binding required by100.
newMaterialFindings.smallAcceptanceCase: Alter only stored reservation entryId to an imported copy, keeping opID/cap and input hashes. Return the original server binding. Assert mismatch/refusal, original ready retained and neither project modified. Not executed by this reviewer.
